messages.subject: unusual back Transform estimate????
parts:
Currently estimating covariates that influence the occupancy and detection of the common opossum

I have my top model for occupancy and detection shown below 


M167<-occu(~Human + House ~Trail + CanopyCover+Slope+ Elevation + Water,wt)

When i backTransform the estimate for detection, i can only include the detection covariates (human and house), 
of which gives me 0.348, higher than the detection value of the data excluding covariates

However, when back Transforming for occupancy I get this value = 2.28e-09 

What does this mean???? 

Is it as high as it can possibly go, therefore when including this covariates, occupancy will be 100%?
